adapterState: off until the vendor record exists in the compliance register (T-14 gate, TASK-064); no DSN is set before then
organisation: one Sentry organisation shared by api, worker, web and monitor

scrub.beforeSend: createScrubHook (apps/api/src/platform/metrics/sentry.ts): scrubbed copy; user, request data, cookies, headers and query string removed; a hook failure drops the event
serverSideRules: sensitive fields: authorization, cookie, token, key, secret, password, email
scrub.monitorEvents: message with the rule ID and numbers only; no URL, token or response body

issueAlerts.action: email owner and administrators; auto-resolve after 30 minutes without a new event (ALR-3 recovery rule)

fallback: if Sentry issue alerts are not available on the free tier, the uptime vendor's webhook-to-email carries the monitor events (VERIFY)
